name: Organic Quinoa Bowl
description: A wholesome bowl with organic quinoa, roasted vegetables, and a light olive oil dressing.
ingredients: Organic quinoa, water, olive oil, lemon juice, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, sea salt, black pepper
notes: LOWER CONCERN. Clean ingredients, no major allergens, heart-healthy.

name: Fresh Berry Smoothie
description: A fresh blend of mixed berries and unsweetened almond milk with chia seeds.
ingredients: Strawberries, blueberries, unsweetened almond milk (filtered water, almonds), chia seeds
notes: LOWER CONCERN. Good for heart health, diabetes-friendly.

name: Grilled Salmon & Asparagus
description: Wild-caught salmon fillet grilled with fresh asparagus spears and lemon.
ingredients: Wild-caught salmon, asparagus, olive oil, lemon juice, sea salt, garlic, black pepper
notes: LOWER CONCERN. Excellent source of omega-3s and lean protein.

name: Avocado Sourdough Toast
description: Mashed avocado on artisanal sourdough bread topped with microgreens.
ingredients: Sourdough bread (wheat flour, water, salt, natural starter), avocado, microgreens, lime juice, sea salt, red pepper flakes
notes: LOWER CONCERN. Contains wheat, but otherwise heart-healthy and low in sugar.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
description: A refreshing salad of chickpeas, cucumbers, feta cheese, and herbs.
ingredients: Chickpeas, cucumbers, red onions, feta cheese (pasteurized milk, salt, cultures, enzymes), olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, black pepper
notes: LOWER CONCERN. Great source of plant-based fiber and protein. Contains dairy (feta).

name: Baked Sweet Potato Wedges
description: Oven-baked sweet potato wedges dusted with cinnamon and paprika.
ingredients: Sweet potatoes, olive oil, cinnamon, smoked paprika, sea salt
notes: LOWER CONCERN. High in vitamin A and complex carbohydrates. No added sugar.
